profile.name: QuTech SPI S4g通量电流源
profile.name_en: QuTech SPI S4g Flux Current Source
profile.description: 一款多通道通量电流源，用于实验中为通量偏置线提供和管理电流输出。该设备支持将各通道安全缓慢降到零电流，适合超导量子比特等需要稳定直流偏置的场景。
profile.description_en: A multi-channel flux current source used in experiments to provide and manage current output for flux-bias lines. It supports safely ramping channels down to zero current, making it suitable for setups such as superconducting qubits that require stable DC biasing.
